title: R4-B2 pre-registration: pixel-adjacency edge learning POC. Committed before Stage 1-4 runs and before any training.
basis: R4-B1T closed as pre-registered FAIL (A: C2, C3; B: C3, C4 literal). Owner approved one B-based training run. Historical results unchanged.
baseline: M2_hybrid (R4-A2.2 M2 best.pt, sha256 in experiments/R4B0/gate0/baseline_manifest_r4a2_2.json; hybrid_markers post-processing)
change_policy: One formal training. After this commit only crash / implementation-bug fixes, documented with reason. No change to loss, weights, threshold, reconstruction, sheets or metrics after seeing any validation or test result. No second training.

model.backbone: experiments/R4A/r4a2_train.UNet (4 down / 4 up, base 24, BatchNorm, bilinear), random init seed 20261029

training.data: freeze_config.json data_roles: train = 10 frozen sheets, validation_model_selection = 15023 / 15041 (checkpoint selection only)
training.frozen_from_r4a2: tile 512, batch 8, sampling mix and anchors (r4a2_train.load_sheet, INCLUDING the first-pixel small_instance_centre anchor, unchanged), augmentation, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4, cosine to 1e-5 over 20000 steps, validation every 1000 steps on 64 fixed tiles, early stop after 5 non-improving validations, wall-clock cap 110 min, device MPS
training.sampling_anchor_fix: NOT included (keeps the run single-factor: only the boundary representation and its loss change)
training.targets: edge_right / edge_down recomputed from the augmented unit crop; supervised only where both pixels are valid (ignore == 0, unit >= 0)

loss.near_edge_rule: a supervised non-edge pair of one orientation within the 3x3 neighbourhood of a true edge of the same orientation (1 px registration uncertainty, R4-B1T Gate 3: 9/10 training sheets offset ~1 px)
loss.rationale: chosen from training-sheet evidence and the pos_weight of earlier runs; no validation result used. pos_weight 4: with a 1 px ambiguity the per-position optimum of two candidate positions is ~0.8 > 0.5, which favours closed (thick) separations over gaps that would merge units

training.checkpoint: best validation loss (frozen rule); weights local only, sha256 committed

reconstruction.rule: pair separated iff edge probability > 0.5; 4-connected components of all pixels over non-separated pairs; regions < 50 px merged into the neighbour with the lowest mean edge probability on their shared border (smallest first)
reconstruction.dist_channel_use: auxiliary supervision only; not used for regions

stage1.gt_check: on the 10 training sheets: reconstruction from official edges (probabilities 0/1) must equal the valid-restricted 4-connected unit components exactly, and the edges implied by the reconstructed regions must equal the official edges; any mismatch stops training
stage1.synthetic: tests/r4b2/test_r4b2_edges.py (thin strip, pinch-out, bend, checkerboard, invalid band, single-pixel connection, cleanup, edge metrics)

cases.shift_1px: all edges moved by one pair in a random direction per sheet

metrics: instances absorbed (best-overlap region holds >= 2 instances with >= 50% of their area)
perturbation.note: robustness of the reconstruction only, not a model result

stage3_test_sheets.rule: walk experiments/R4B1T/gate5_candidates.json in order (13076, 14030, 14071, 15094, 13015, ...); download and apply the unchanged Q1/Q2/Q3 rules of experiments/R4A/gtf_dataset.process; stop at 2 PASS; record every visited sheet
stage3_test_sheets.timing: after the B2 checkpoint is frozen; labels (r4a2_labels.build) are built only after the inference code and evaluation rules are committed
stage3_test_sheets.first_evaluation: one run of M2_hybrid and B2 on the two test sheets, with the frozen code; no re-run

stage4_metrics.instance: experiments/R4A/r4a2_2_eval.instance_metrics (unchanged): small recall, under/over-seg, absorbed, large recall, regions; per width bin 3-6 / 6-10 / 10-20 px with experiments/R4B1T/r4b1t_width
stage4_metrics.edges: pair-level P / R / F1, strict and 1-pair tolerance (r4b2_edges.edge_metrics), on supervised pairs
stage4_metrics.thin_units: for 3-6 / 6-10 px instances: share whose best-overlap region contains no other instance's majority (kept separate), and recall
stage4_metrics.merge_sensitivity: regions that hold the majority of >= 2 small instances; number of instances in such regions; share of small-instance failures caused by such merges
stage4_metrics.shared_boundary: share of true adjacent instance pairs that are separated in the prediction (both instances' best regions differ)
stage4_metrics.boundary_F1: region boundaries vs UNIT_BOUNDARY at 1 / 2 / 3 px (r4a2_2_eval.boundary_metrics, unchanged)
stage4_metrics.vector: export with experiments/R4A/r4a2_2_export.py and validate_pixel_vectors.py (9 checks)
stage4_metrics.cost: training minutes, inference seconds, peak memory

stage5_decision.A_keep_as_candidate: B2 small recall >= M2_hybrid + 0.02 on BOTH independent test sheets and over-seg increase <= 0.03
stage5_decision.B_learning_insufficient: official-edge reconstruction exact (Stage 1) but B2 edge recall (tol1) < 0.85 on test sheets, or 3-6 / 6-10 px recall not above M2_hybrid
stage5_decision.C_merge_errors: share of small-instance failures caused by multi-instance merges >= 0.5 on test sheets
stage5_decision.multiple: report every condition that holds; primary choice in order A, C, B, D
